thag5.1:1.1:
I, a monk,
gone to the charnel ground,
thag5.1:2.4:
as if I were blind
to the oozings.
thag5.1:3.1:
In less time than it takes
for rice to cook,
thag5.1:3.2: I got out of that place.
thag5.1:4.1: Then apt attention arose in me,
thag5.1:5.1: With that, my heart was released.
thag5.1:5.3:
The three knowledges
have been attained;
